bio: Tree shows Catherine Neagle 1770-Deceased, wife of Patrick Heffernan. 'Neagle' is probably Nagle, a Cork landed family; the Neagle and Kearney generations have no sources. Removed from Andrew H. Heffernan's line.
sources: Johnny Meier's Ancestry tree (screenshots IMG_7791-7840 in John's Google Drive), transcribed in research/tree_transcription.md and Ancestry tree screenshots (section 2.2.2)

Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
